title: Reorder within a lane, only between nodes with no dependency
goal: A drag or keyboard move inside a lane proposes a new order, or is refused with its reason
acceptance: Uses the sortable interaction of bx-sortable-list (F-015-T01): pointer, touch and keyboard (grab, arrows, drop, Escape), inside one lane only; no second implementation of it

A move that would cross a node it may not pass is refused: the node returns to place, a polite live region and a visible message give the reason from the input ("X depends on Y"), and the component emits reorderRefused; an allowed move emits reorderRequest with the ids in the new order, and the component never persists it
Tests: allowed move, refused move with its reason, Escape cancels, keyboard-only reorder; axe-clean in every theme
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: The sortable interaction already exists (F-015); this step restricts it by the input's may-not-pass lists and adds the refusal. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
